result.reasoning: This commit ("Add RBD support for primary storage") introduced the original RBD options string construction in KVMPhysicalDisk.java, including the line `rbdOpts += ":mon_host=" + monHost + "\\\\:" + monPort;` which contains the double-escaped colon (`\\\\:` instead of `\\:`). Subsequent commits (fb9ceba93bbd, c3554ec31daf) modified surrounding logic (conditional on port) but retained the same double-escape bug, which the fix commit d33e5278b2 finally corrects by changing `\\\\:` to `\\:`. Since this is the commit that first wrote the double-escaped separator, it is the root cause.
